text:
zoe (people-ops): quick heads-up: visitor Maria from Greenleaf arriving 4:10pm with a stroller and a medium framed print. also asked if we could chill a small sealed jar in the fridge (breastmilk). can we have stroller parking + badge color + fridge spot? :baby: :framed_picture:

marta (reception): noted. i'll pre-print a guest badge. what color should we use so security can spot temporary parents?

kai (eng): lime? but maybe teal like our other guest tags. teal stands out against badges. i'll be in the lobby at 4:05 to help carry the print if needed.

ricardo (facilities): stroller parking ok near the coat rack by the north bench. framed print can go to parcel shelf labeled. fridge ok but please ask them to label jar with name + date. we can't store open food.

frontdesk-bot: [AUTOREPLY] Visitor registered: Maria (Greenleaf). Badge scheduled for printing at 16:07. Access QR expires in 8 hours.

zoe (people-ops): label suggestion: `Maria  Greenleaf  03/23  breastmilk (sealed)` (we use the small sticker labels by the printer).

marta (reception): good call. i'll attach sticker and put jar on top shelf marked "People Ops - Guest fridge". stroller spot reserved. badge color: teal by reactions.

kai (eng): bringing dolly just in case the print is heavy  DM me if you want help getting it up the stairs.

zoe (people-ops): small poll: teal or lime? react with :large_blue_circle: for teal, :green_heart: for lime

(reactions rolling): :large_blue_circle: x3, :green_heart: x1

marta (reception): badge printed and on the desk. jar labeled and in fridge. stroller parked. leaving a sticky note with guest wifi: Guest-Redwood-4321.

zoe (people-ops): thanks all! i'll meet Maria at north lobby at 4:10 and escort to the demo room. if anyone wants to join the quick 5-minute tour after, ping me. :tada:
